summary: Reexecuted auth regression and responsive UI coverage. Forgot-password email-only and five-failure lockout pass; registration, login/session, dashboard, logout, theme toggle, and mobile layout/menu pass. Public ingress still returns wildcard CORS without credentials, and the frontend forgot-password control does not call the API.

critical.issue: Public URL responds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, despite backend middleware being configured for the explicit frontend origin.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking forgot-password only sets local text and never POSTs to /api/auth/forgot-password; this is a MOCKED frontend flow even though the backend endpoint works.

action_items: Fix the public proxy/ingress CORS handling so the frontend origin is explicit and allow-credentials is true; backend code alone is not reflected publicly.
Wire forgot-password button to POST /api/auth/forgot-password with email and show loading/error/success state without revealing account existence.
critical_code_review_comments: The public CORS contract remains broken: browser credentialed requests can be blocked even though FastAPI CORSMiddleware is configured correctly.
Frontend auth has no API integration for forgot-password and currently presents success-like recovery text without sending a request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed flows (registration, dashboard, theme, logout, mobile layout/menu)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ users for backend lockout and UI registration checks; no non-test users were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest public OPTIONS CORS response and click forgot-password while observing the network request. Core auth/session/dashboard and responsive checks are passing.
rca of the issue: The backend uses explicit FRONTEND_URL, but the public Cloudflare/proxy response rewrites preflight headers to wildcard and removes credentials support. The React forgot-password handler only calls setError and has no axios request, so it cannot exercise the implemented endpoint.
